sn54.1:1.3: ekadhammo bhikkhave bhāvito bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.1:1.6: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānassati kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.
sn54.1:1.7: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
sn54.1:2.1: dīghaṃ vā assasanto dīghaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti dīghaṃ vā passasanto dīghaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti.
sn54.1:2.2: rassaṃ vā assasanto rassaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti rassaṃ vā passasanto rassaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti.
sn54.1:2.3: sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:2.4: passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:3.1: pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati pītipaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:3.2: sukhapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati sukhapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:3.3: cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:3.4: passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:4.1: cittapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati cittapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:4.2: abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:4.3: samādahaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati samādahaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:4.4: vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:5.2: virāgānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati virāgānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:5.3: nirodhānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati nirodhānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:5.4: paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.1:6.1: evaṃ bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānassati evaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsāti.
